about: Files the chart factory (the poker repo) runs as COPIES of this repo's. This repo is the source: edit them here, never in the factory. The factory takes them with `bun scripts/sync_from_wrapper.ts --commit` (run in the factory checkout, C:\Users\Brady\poker); until it does, `bun setup/live.ts` and both dashboard bars show the factory as behind. Each file must import only node:/bun: modules and other files in this list, so the copy runs the same there.
